title: TripleSix S3 axis/orientation and 64-to-63 cube-grid fold bridge audit

authority_boundary: Internal bounded formal-design evidence only. The audit may establish an S3 axis/orientation address and an explicitly declared finite-grid quotient. It does not recover the historical visual generator, identify the visuals with a cube mechanism, establish a physical fold, select a historical Janus law, create a Study or Family, or authorize publication.

verify the axis-pair plus parity address is bijective
compare commuting and dihedral action conventions without selecting historical intent
verify q64_63 is surjective, non-injective and has one two-element pivot fibre
